model_annotation: This donut chart displays the relative shares in percent for various public expenditure categories in the years 2014 (inner ring) and 2021 (outer ring). The chart is divided into 16 segments, each representing a different sector such as “Kultur” (Culture), “Wohnungswesen” (Housing), “Abwasserentsorgung” (Wastewater Disposal), “Stromversorgung” (Electricity Supply), and “Übrige” (Other), among others. Each segment is color-coded and labeled with its corresponding percentage for both years, allowing for direct comparison. The largest share in both years is “Übrige,” at 38.1% in 2014 and 31.1% in 2021. Other notable categories include “Wasserversorgung” (Water Supply) at 8.8% in 2021 and “Stromversorgung” (Electricity Supply) at 8.9% in 2021. The chart uses a consistent color scheme across both rings for each category, with percentage values clearly marked next to each segment. No legend is provided, as labels are directly connected to their respective slices via leader lines. The segments are arranged in a clockwise order, though not strictly by size.
